title: Clear the rights before building
statement: Clear the rights to every text, clip and image before building on it, since viewing rights don't cover excerpts and a withdrawn text takes everything built on it.
detail: For a Grade 9 plan to compare two stage productions, every published licence found granted platform viewing, not clip extraction or embedding in another app, so each holder needed a direct rights conversation, with a text-only comparison as the fallback (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0202-g9-othello-video-research-fake-ai-attention.qmd`). The edition chosen for the text is free for non-commercial use, with attribution and a link to the licence required (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0251-g9-prep-pack-index-manifests-leadership-playbook.qmd`). In the reading project, teaching materials offered in a meeting were leads, not a licence: receipt, rights and permitted use are confirmed before any goes into a training corpus (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0172-g3-reading-course-feedback-2026-08-04.qmd`).
